title: Conversation memory: running summary, follow-up rewriting and recall
description: Keep recent turns verbatim, fold older turns into a persisted, versioned, incrementally updated summary built by a background job, rewrite follow-up questions into standalone search queries, and recall relevant earlier turns by embedding. Local chats compact with their local model; hosted chats with Luna. Original messages are never altered.
acceptance_criteria: Given a 40-turn conversation, when asking about a fact from turn 2, then the answer uses the summary or recalled turn and stays within budget.
Given a completed turn over the threshold, when compaction runs twice for the same range, then exactly one summary version is produced.
Given a local chat, when compaction runs, then no hosted model is called.
Given a follow-up such as 'how did it compare to the baselines?', when retrieving, then the persisted standalone query names the subject and the retrieved evidence matches it.
Given the planner fails, when a question is asked, then the deterministic fallback query is used and the answer still completes.
test_cases: Compaction job idempotency on real Postgres; planner structured-output fixtures; recall retrieval tests; long-conversation fixture.
